mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_friend (user_id, friend_id, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{friendId}, 'pending')
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, friend_id AS friendId, status FROM user_friend WHERE (user_id = #{userId} AND friend_id = #{friendId}) OR (user_id = #{friendId} AND friend_id = #{userId}) LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE user_friend SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id} AND friend_id = #{userId} AND status = 'pending'
mapper.select: SELECT f.id AS relId, CASE WHEN f.user_id = #{userId} THEN f.friend_id ELSE f.user_id END AS friendId, u.name, u.username, u.avatar, u.role FROM user_friend f JOIN user u ON u.id = (CASE WHEN f.user_id = #{userId} THEN f.friend_id ELSE f.user_id END) WHERE f.status = 'accepted' AND (f.user_id = #{userId} OR f.friend_id = #{userId}) ORDER BY f.create_time DESC

SELECT f.id AS relId, f.user_id AS fromUserId, u.name, u.username, u.avatar, u.create_time AS requestTime FROM user_friend f JOIN user u ON u.id = f.user_id WHERE f.friend_id = #{userId} AND f.status = 'pending' ORDER BY f.create_time DESC

SELECT f.id AS relId, f.friend_id AS toUserId, u.name, u.username, u.avatar, u.create_time AS requestTime FROM user_friend f JOIN user u ON u.id = f.friend_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND f.status = 'pending' ORDER BY f.create_time DESC

SELECT m.id, m.sender_id AS senderId, m.receiver_id AS receiverId, m.content, m.is_read AS isRead, m.create_time AS createTime, su.name AS senderName FROM friend_message m JOIN user su ON su.id = m.sender_id WHERE (m.sender_id = #{senderId} AND m.receiver_id = #{receiverId}) OR (m.sender_id = #{receiverId} AND m.receiver_id = #{senderId}) ORDER BY m.create_time ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO friend_message (sender_id, receiver_id, content) VALUES (#{senderId}, #{receiverId}, #{content})
mapper.update: UPDATE friend_message SET is_read = 1 WHERE sender_id = #{senderId} AND receiver_id = #{receiverId} AND is_read = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM friend_message WHERE receiver_id = #{receiverId} AND sender_id = #{senderId} AND is_read = 0

SELECT f.id, f.user_id AS userId, f.friend_id AS friendId, f.status, f.create_time AS createTime, u1.name AS userName, u2.name AS friendName FROM user_friend f JOIN user u1 ON u1.id = f.user_id JOIN user u2 ON u2.id = f.friend_id ORDER BY f.create_time DESC

SELECT m.id, m.sender_id AS senderId, m.receiver_id AS receiverId, m.content, m.is_read AS isRead, m.create_time AS createTime, su.name AS senderName, ru.name AS receiverName FROM friend_message m JOIN user su ON su.id = m.sender_id JOIN user ru ON ru.id = m.receiver_id ORDER BY m.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}

mapper.delete: DELETE FROM user_follow WHERE follower_id = #{followerId} AND following_id = #{followingId}
